name: StockTitan News Feed
author: StockTitan

sections.description:
StockTitan News Feed is a server-rendered Gutenberg block by StockTitan that brings timely, reliable headlines from the StockTitan platform directly to your site.

  • Server-rendered: Renders on the server for fast, SEO-friendly output.
  • Theming: Presets and CSS variables let the block blend with your theme.
  • Controls: Toggle logo/date/summary/tag, limit items, choose date format.
  • Secure token: The API token is stored as encrypted constants and decrypted on this site only.
  • Translation-ready: Includes a POT file and supports multiple languages.

Block registration is powered by block.json and compiled assets in build/.

About StockTitan

Transforming complex market data into actionable intelligence

Welcome to StockTitan, where we empower investors and traders with timely, reliable, simple, and effective financial information and tools. Our mission is to transform complex market data into practical, actionable tools that help you navigate the stock market with confidence.

We combine our deep market experience, technological expertise, and your valuable feedback to create a platform that truly serves your investment needs—whether you’re a seasoned professional or just beginning your trading journey.

Translations

This plugin is fully internationalized and ready for translation.

  • Text domain: stocktitan-news-feed-block
  • Domain path: /languages
  • Bundled: languages/stocktitan-news-feed-block.pot
  • Supported locales: German (de_DE), French (fr_FR), Italian (it_IT), Spanish (es_ES)

You can provide translations via the WordPress.org translation platform or by including .mo/.po files in languages/.

Data and privacy

  • External request: The block fetches JSON news data from https://stocktitan.net:11101/api/news/json.
  • Personal data: No personal user data is sent; requests include only your API token.
  • Caching: Responses may be cached in-memory during the request lifecycle.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP via the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Add the “StockTitan News Feed” block to a post or page.

Token setup:

  • The plugin expects an encrypted token payload via constants STNF_TOKEN_CIPHERTEXT and STNF_TOKEN_IV. These are decrypted using your site salts (AUTH_SALT and SECURE_AUTH_KEY).
  • Paste the generated base64 values into wp-config.php or keep the default defines in stocktitan-news-feed.php updated.
sections.faq:
Where do I set my API token?

Provide the encrypted values via the constants STNF_TOKEN_CIPHERTEXT and STNF_TOKEN_IV. The plugin derives the encryption key from your site salts so only your WordPress install can decrypt it.

Which languages are supported?

The plugin is translation-ready. We target at least German (de_DE), French (fr_FR), Italian (it_IT), and Spanish (es_ES). You can supply translations via WordPress.org or ship .mo files in languages/.

Does this collect personal data?

No. It only requests news data from StockTitan using your token. No user-identifying data is sent.
